title: Roken, drinken en drugsgebruik door scholieren vanaf 10 jaar 1988-1989
authors: Plomp, H.N., Oers, M.L. van, Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam * Amsterdam, Instituut sociale geneeskunde, Kuipers, H., Nederlands instituut voor alcohol en drugs, NIAD * Utrecht (primary investigator)
contributors: M.L. van Oers, Vrije universiteit, Instituut sociale geneeskunde (depositor)
Ministerie van welzijn, volksgezondheid en cultuur * Rijswijk (research initiator)
Nederlands instituut voor alcohol en drugs
descriptions: Smoking habits, alcohol consumption and the use of drugs by schoolchildren from the age of ten / frequency of absence, truancy / having a payed job, earnings allowance / knowledge of hashish and marihuana / use of alcohol, tobacco, amphetamines, sedatives, marihuana, hashish, cocaine, heroine, glue etc. / frequency and quantity of use, now and in past / reaction of parents / use of alcohol, tobacco and drugs by friends / obtainability of alcohol and drugs. Background variables: basic characteristics/ place of birth/ residence/ occupation/employment/ education/ religion
